objective.statement: Add private/opt-in telemetry types and exact validators before solver instrumentation.
objective.observable_success: Focused RED→GREEN tests enforce schema, checked accounting, terminal states, and claim boundary.
non_goals: Changing scientific tolerances or expected outputs

P0_failure_modes.trigger: Overflow or counter mismatch is accepted.

P1_failure_modes.trigger: ERROR receipt lacks stage identity and preserved work.
Public API or production default is changed merely to expose telemetry.

forbidden_changes: Do not change reference tolerances or expected scientific outputs to make tests pass.
Do not guess across a scientific or numerical specification boundary.
Do not suppress failed stages, cells, tests, or Atlassian drift.

invariants.statement: Stage terminal states are exhaustive and failure preserving.
Residual-sign coverage is separate from norm telemetry.
